atlas.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: transparent modular pixel-art game sprite atlas. Create ONE precisely organized 1024 by 1024 transparent PNG atlas, 4 columns x 4 rows of equally sized 256px square cells, no grid lines, no text. Each isolated object centered within its own cell, ample transparent margin and absolutely no overlap between cells. Cohesive richly crafted pixel-art medieval jousting assets around 1250-1300, large clean pixel clusters, dark outlines, warm steel and leather, detailed but readable, neutral light upper left. Rider torso three-quarter toward viewer while facing right: visible chest front and both shoulders, NOT strict profile, not top-down. No late Renaissance full plate. Listed in strict reading order: row1 cell1 BLUE surcoat over chainmail TORSO ONLY from shoulders to belt, headless armless legless with small shoulder attachment stubs; cell2 separate steel flat-topped great helm HEAD ONLY in three-quarter right view with narrow eye slit; cell3 detached chainmail upper ARM segment pointing downward with rounded shoulder overlap; cell4 detached chainmail FOREARM and leather gloved fist pointing right horizontally. Row2 cell1 brown horse BODY ONLY with saddle on top and tail to left, no head no neck no legs; cell2 brown horse NECK AND HEAD ONLY facing right, leather bridle, attachment base at lower left; cell3 one isolated horse upper LEG pointing downward; cell4 one isolated horse lower LEG and dark HOOF pointing downward. Row3 cell1 blue wooden heater SHIELD with gold diagonal band facing viewer obliquely; cell2 red wooden heater SHIELD with cream geometric chevron; cell3 rider seated THIGH AND BOOT LEG assembly bent down, leather boot with mail-covered knee; cell4 flowing small blue pennon/banner on a short attachment, no pole. Row4 cell1 RED surcoat chainmail TORSO matching row1 torso; cell2 alternate steel great helm head, gold trim, same scale; cell3 small steel multi-pronged CORONEL lance tip facing right; cell4 small sharp steel lance head facing right. All 16 parts are separate production parts, not full characters; shield not attached to arm; torso no head, no weapon. Keep physical anatomy and coherent sizes within individual cells. Transparent background must be true alpha, no checkerboard and no shadow ground.
atlas.notes: Generated source is 1254x1254 RGBA. Manually inspected. Rectangular atlas regions are sampled by Godot; no claim of an exact 256px grid.

arena.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: finished background painting for a horizontal 2D medieval jousting game. Landscape wide 16:9 composition, detailed hand-crafted pixel-art, coherent crisp pixel clusters, restrained earthy palette, late afternoon golden light and a dusty muted sage sky. A believable European tournament field around 1250-1300, a distant stone castle on low hills at left, medieval striped cloth pavilions in deep muted red, forest green and ochre, wood spectator galleries with tiny distant crowd silhouettes across the middle distance, heraldic banners without text. View nearly side-on with a slight angle to show depth, NOT top-down. Upper third atmospheric sky and hills, middle third galleries and tents, lower half open sandy riding ground in warm desaturated ochre. The very lower edge hints of grass. No near characters, no horses, no foreground weapons, no foreground fence or rail, no combatants. Keep the central riding area visually quiet for the separate rider sprites and rail. Rich atmospheric layered scenery with dark pine silhouettes near edges, subtle dust, no UI no lettering no logo no watermark. This is a directly usable game background, not a screenshot mockup, no borders.
arena.notes: 1672x941 generated background; scaled by engine. Historically inspired fictional venue, not a specific site reconstruction.
